events.title: Cyclone Fani
events.summary: A cyclone formed in the Bay of Bengal and came ashore near Puri on the coast of Odisha, eastern India.
events.source_name: India Meteorological Department (RSMC New Delhi), cyclone report

events.title: Cyclone Titli
events.summary: A cyclone formed in the Bay of Bengal and made landfall on the coast of Andhra Pradesh, eastern India.
events.source_name: India Meteorological Department (RSMC New Delhi), cyclone report

events.title: Cyclone Amphan
events.summary: A cyclone formed in the Bay of Bengal and came ashore on the West Bengal coast near Bakkhali, India.

events.title: Strong positive Indian Ocean Dipole
events.summary: A strong positive Indian Ocean Dipole developed, with warm water in the western Indian Ocean and cool water west of Sumatra.
events.source_name: CSIRO, Climate summary for the southern hemisphere 2019 to 2020
